author: sweeeper
body:
Hi guys, I'm still furious on myself for deleting Venator but I went ahead and made Proelium II anyway. Hope you like it!


(this map is bigger then it looks, these images are taken with max render distance)

IMAGES: http://imgur.com/a/TKMfm

MAP DOWNLOAD: Download will be availible as soon as Alexanderjoe10 gives me the map folder ^^

YAML DOWNLOAD: Not done yet. I would greatly appreciate if someone could make it for me. I already have to coordinates for the spawns and the monuments ready.

This map consists of two teams, yellow and purple. 3 monuments for each team. There's some sweet loot hiden here and there but that's up to you to find. If you have Alexanderjoe10's server ip you can chek this map out for yourself if you'd like.
Just type: /mvtp sweeeperdmt#1

Tribute to Venator:

I cri evy tme ;(
